title: gtm-cs-1on1-prep-priya-nair-ethan-morales-2026-03-10
content:
Purpose:
- Prep for weekly 1:1 with Ethan (AE) — align on top accounts, escalations, renewal posture, and specific asks for next 2 weeks. Keep to 30 min.

Agenda (30m):
1) Quick wins / shoutouts (3m)
2) Top account deep dives (15m) — AcmeCorp, Zephyr Analytics, NovaHealth
3) Escalations / blocker triage (6m)
4) Asks / handoffs (5m)
5) Confirm action items + next check-in (1m)

Topline (what I want Ethan to know before we talk):
- Q2 renewal pipeline: $1.6M (committed + likely). Two at-risk: AcmeCorp ($350k) and NovaHealth ($120k).
- Product usage for top 5 accounts: AcmeCorp token consumption down ~28% last 14 days (alerts flagged), Zephyr up 12% MoM, NovaHealth onboarding lagging.
- Support tickets: AcmeCorp opened high-priority perf ticket (CS-419) -> assigned to infra SRE.

Account notes / talking points:
1) AcmeCorp (Renewal Oct 2026 — $350k ARR)
   - Current mood: neutral -> slipping. CSM notes: slower usage, multiple performance complaints during peak hours.
   - Recent events: performance incident on 2026-03-05 (CS-419). SE remediation plan in progress (workaround deployed 2026-03-09).
   - Risk indicators: lower token volume, exec sponsor quiet, decision-maker rotation.
   - Ask for Ethan: schedule an exec sync with Acme CTO + propose reserved Dedicated trial for 4 weeks (show predictable p99). Can you lead outreach this week?
   - Relevant artifacts: JIRA CS-419, confluence link CONFLUENCE-ACCOUNTS-742 (performance postmortem draft).

2) Zephyr Analytics (Expansion opportunity — $180k potential)
   - Current mood: enthusiastic. Engineering using APIs heavily; success story candidate.
   - Signals: spike in embeddings usage and new internal demo last week.
   - Ask for Ethan: push for case study permission + introduce AE to partnerships team to open cross-sell into analytics org. Also check if they want Assistants pilot.

3) NovaHealth (Onboarding / renewal 2026-11 — $120k)
   - Current mood: concerned about data ingestion speed and PHI compliance questions. CTO asked about Private deployment options.
   - Blocker: integration with their ETL; SE requested additional logs.
   - Ask for Ethan: escalate to Solutions Eng to scope Private deployment feasibility and get KMS/HSM answers. Can you coordinate a deep-dive with SE next week?

Escalations / blockers (quick):
- CS-419 (AcmeCorp perf) — SRE assigned, ETA for full fix: 2026-03-17. Ask: set expectation with customer and offer temporary burst capacity.
- PHI questions from NovaHealth — Security/compliance reply needed. Ask: can we get SOC2+HIPAA FAQ doc from security team and loop Legal?

Opportunities / wins to capture:
- Zephyr demo -> candidate for Q2 case study. Need a short testimonial + metrics (before/after latency/cost).
- Internal enablement: draft for "how to pitch Dedicated vs Hosted" needs real customer examples. Could use Acme (if we can stabilize) and Zephyr.

Asks I have for Ethan (specific):
- This week: reach out to Acme CTO and get exec sync scheduled (owner: Ethan; due: 2026-03-12).
- Coordinate Solutions Eng + NovaHealth deep-dive (owner: Ethan; due: 2026-03-17).
- Push Zephyr for case study + testimonial (owner: Ethan; due: 2026-03-24).
- Confirm if AE can include a small credits offer for Acme to keep traffic while fix lands (owner: Ethan; due: 2026-03-11).

My asks / what I will bring:
- I'll draft the Acme CTO email + proposed agenda for exec sync and share before EOD 2026-03-10.
- I'll continue monitoring CS-419 and keep SRE/SE updates in the ticket.
- I'll assemble a one-pager on Dedicated trial benefits for Acme (cost, SLA promises, onboarding checklist).

Proposed action items (with owners & due dates):
- Ethan: schedule Acme exec sync — due 2026-03-12.
- Ethan: coordinate SE deep-dive for NovaHealth + collect ETL logs — due 2026-03-17.
- Priya: draft Acme exec email + agenda — due 2026-03-10 (I will send before our 1:1).
- Priya: follow up with security/legal for NovaHealth PHI FAQ — due 2026-03-13.
- Ethan: request Zephyr case study approval and metrics — due 2026-03-24.
- Priya: update CS-419 ticket with interim mitigation notes — ongoing (next update 2026-03-11).

Metrics / data to review in call (prep):
- Acme: token volume last 30d, error-rate p99 latency, open tickets count. (I will pull and paste charts into Confluence).
- Zephyr: embedding usage, demo KPIs.

Notes to self (things to listen for during call):
- Any language indicating budget tightening or vendor consolidation at Acme — escalate early.
- Who's the new exec sponsor? (record contact info)
- If Zephyr is open to a quote, ask about timeline to commit.

Follow-up:
- After 1:1, I will send a recap with action items and owners. Add all items to JIRA-CS board and link to CONFLUENCE-ACCOUNTS-742.
- Next sync: schedule for 2026-03-17 (15 min check-in) to confirm status on Acme and NovaHealth.

Misc / scratchpad ideas: 
- Pilot idea: 4-week Dedicated trial with performance SLA for at-risk accounts (template + internal pricing).
- Playbook: what to offer when customer reports peak perf issues (credits, burst, temporary routing, SE onsite).

Quick links (to paste into calendar invite):
- Acme performance postmortem: https://confluence.company/ACCOUNTS-742
- CS ticket: https://jira.company/browse/CS-419
- SE playbook draft: https://docs.google.com/document/d/SE-playbook
summary: Prep doc for weekly 1:1 between Priya (CSM) and Ethan (AE). Focus: Acme at-risk renewal, Zephyr expansion, NovaHealth onboarding, clear asks and deadlines.
